name: buy_domain
description: Executes a single-domain registration previously quoted by get_purchase_quote (product:domain); this tool rejects calls without a valid quote. The quote is presented to the user for explicit approval, then this tool is called with confirm:true, the quote's idempotencyKey, the expectedPrice and years from the quote, and the full registrant contact supplied by the user. The purchase is charged immediately and is non-refundable. Vercel stores no reusable registrant profile, so contact details are required each time. The quote returns disclosures the user must see before approving: the payment method (default card on file), that taxes/fees may apply on top of the price, the item terms (non-refundable), and, when auto-renew is on, the recurring-charge terms in disclosures.subscription (renews automatically each term at the then-current price until auto-renew is turned off), plus a full-terms link.

autoRenew.description: Whether to auto-renew at the end of the term. Defaults to true.

confirm.description: Set true to execute the purchase; requires the idempotencyKey from get_purchase_quote.

contact.description: Registrant (WHOIS) contact. Not needed for the quote; REQUIRED on confirm. All fields must be provided.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code, e.g. US

expectedPrice.description: Required on confirm: the purchasePrice (USD) from the quote. The server rejects the order if it no longer matches the live price.

teamId.description:
The ID or slug of the team that owns the resource.
Team IDs start with "team_".
If you do not know the team ID or slug, it can be found through these mechanism:
- Read the file .vercel/project.json if it exists and extract the orgId
- Use the `list_teams` tool

years.description: Registration term in years. Required on confirm — must match the term shown in the quote.
